Description
The 2024 Year of The Dragon 1 oz Argor Heraeus gold bar is a high-quality investment product made by one of the world’s leading precious metals refineries. Each Argor Heraeus gold bar contains 1 troy ounce of 99.99% pure gold, making it a valuable addition to any investment portfolio.
As per the Chinese Zodiac’s 12-year cycle, 2024 heralds the Year of the Dragon, a symbol of power, authority, and good fortune. The cycle is characterized by twelve animals: Rat, Ox, Tiger, Rabbit, Dragon, Snake, Horse, Goat, Monkey, Rooster, Dog, and Pig, each marking a year based on the lunar calendar. Dragons, in Chinese astrology, are revered as intelligent, ambitious, and passionate beings. People born in the Year of the Dragon are believed to embody these noble traits. Commemorate the Year of the Dragon with this majestic gold bar that embodies wealth and wisdom.
The
1 oz Gold Bar
is stamped with the Argor Heraeus logo, the weight and purity of the gold, and a unique serial number for authentication purposes. 1 oz Argor Heraeus gold bars.9999 pure gold also comes with an assay certificate that verifies the weight, purity, and authenticity.
Investors who choose 1 oz Argor Heraeus gold bars can be confident that they are investing in a product of exceptional quality and value. With a long-standing reputation for excellence, Argor Heraeus Gold Bar is a trusted name in the precious metals industry.
Design of 2024 Year Of The Dragon 1 oz Argor Heraeus Gold Bar
Obverse:
Features the notable Argor-Heraeus logo, accompanied by the inscriptions: “Switzerland”, “1 ounce”, “Fine gold”, “999,9”, the assayer’s mark, and a distinct serial number, certifying its premium standard.
Reverse:
Illustrates a majestic dragon grasping the Pearl of Wisdom, a symbolic representation of the Year of the Dragon. The Chinese character denoting “Dragon” is gracefully inscribed below, adding to its grandeur.
Main Highlights of 2024 Year Of The Dragon 1 oz Argor Heraeus Gold Bar
Each Argor Heraeus gold bullion bar contains 1 Oz of .9999 pure gold from the Swiss refinery Argor-Heraeus.
Each argor Heraeus 1 oz gold bar is delivered in a protective sealed assay card.
The 1 oz Argor Heraeus gold bar is eligible for precious metal IRAs.
Features its own Argor-Heraeus logo, Purity, and Weight.
Argor Heraeus Gold Bars has its own unique serial number for added security and theft protection.
